Name: PinkStations Cloud Heart Farm Map
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[size=4][b]~PinkStations Cloud Heart Farm~[/b][/size]
[size=2]My pretty heart farm map (on clouds!). This is an open layout farm shaped like a heart with wings! It has 2 easy access spots for watering plants, 2 waterfalls, A pond for fishing, a quarry, & hardwood stumps spawn locations. It also has a 50% chance for catching mountain fish and forageables spawn![/size]

[size=2]I hope you can enjoy this map and feel free to share a screenshot of your layout! I'd love to see what you can do with it![/size]
